gaps.explanation: Proprietary funds Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p9, Exhibit 7) prints five enterprise columns; Electric, Water and Water Pollution Control have budget schedules in detail[] (H-2 p28, H-5 p30, H-8 p32), but BASWA and Sanitation have no schedule in the trim. BASWA: Charges for services 2,349,347 + Investment earnings 39,542 + Miscellaneous revenues 131,803 = 2,520,692; Sanitation: Charges for services 2,745,489 + Miscellaneous revenues 7,278 = 2,752,767; added 5,273,459. Schedule 23,950,113 + 5,273,459 = 29,223,572 vs statement 29,198,786: the remaining -24,786 is a different basis, not an error: detail records Water 'Gain on disposal of capital assets' 24,786 (p30, detail index 186) as revenue and WPC loss 32,675 as spending (index 199), while the statement lines carry only the net Total-column 'Gain (loss) on disposal of capital asset' (7,889) as one disbursement (p9).
